name: Rig check 5 min
description: Short pre-run check, 5 min. Verifies the whole chain before committing 13 hours: three scope channels at the current ranges, decoupled-free motor control, telemetry, OE capture, and a clean heater-guard exit. Speeds 600/1200/1800 rpm are the same ones the 13 h staircase uses, so UL and AE compare directly against run 20260829_145507 at matching operating points. That comparison matters on 2026-09-01: a retaining ring that holds the bearing in place was found LOOSE and has been fixed, and a rattling ring would have dominated UL/AE in the earlier run. No temperature schedule - the heater is not driven and the Omron is left alone.
